issues.description:
[bug-hunt] In-app Notifications list has dead taps + wrong icons for several backend notification types.

ROOT CAUSE: src/pages/Notifications.tsx type vocabulary (getIconForType, getColorForType, handleNotificationClick switch) is out of sync with the `type` strings the backend actually writes to the notifications table via create_notification/send_notification.

The FE switch only handles: workout_completed, coach_message, admin_message, support_message, weekly_report, daily_summary, diet_reminder, ai_weekly_insight, friend_request, streak_update, plan_update, weekly_review.

But the backend emits these in-app row types (verified in nyu_backend): meal_reminder, workout_reminder, streak_risk (behavior_triggers.py - dispatched with NO meta_data, so no meta_data.link fallback), health_score_changed (scheduler_jobs.py), kudos_received (kudos_routes.py), weekly_review_reminder, mental_health_checkin, partner_session_skipped_fomo.

None of those match the FE switch, so in handleNotificationClick `link` is undefined and the switch hits `default: break` -> tapping the card marks it read but navigates NOWHERE. They also miss getIconForType/getColorForType -> render a generic grey Bell instead of a Flame/Dumbbell/Utensils icon.

EXPECTED: tapping a streak_risk notification goes to /daily-focus, meal_reminder -> /nutrition, workout_reminder -> /activity, health_score_changed -> /health-score, kudos_received -> /social (matching the push pushNotificationActionPerformed handler in src/capacitor/push.ts, which routes these correctly). Icons should match type.
ACTUAL: dead tap + generic bell icon.

REPRO: trigger any behavior notification (e.g. let a >=3 day streak lapse to fire streak_risk, or wait for the midday meal_reminder job) -> open /notifications -> the row shows a plain grey bell -> tap it -> nothing happens (row just marks read).

FIX: align Notifications.tsx type handling with the backend type set (and with push.ts). Note push.ts also uses `health_score_delta` while backend writes `health_score_changed` - a second mismatch to reconcile.

issues.description: [suggestion] Live 16:8 intermittent-fasting timer on the Nutrition page. USER PROBLEM: the app already lets users flag a fasting day (Vrat / Full fast / 16:8 window) but that is a STATIC boolean banner -- it only pauses meal reminders. It does not tell the user where they are IN the fast, which is the whole point of intermittent fasting: how long have I fasted, and when does my eating window open/close? Without a live count, 16:8 is unusable and users abandon it. EVIDENCE: FastingBanner in src/pages/Nutrition.tsx (~lines 47-100) offers a '16:8 window' type but renders no timer/countdown -- a grep shows zero fasting-timer / eating-window code, so the live feature is a genuine gap, not a duplicate. Intermittent fasting is a headline retention feature in every major tracker used in India (HealthifyMe, Zero, Fastic), and vrat/fasting is already culturally central to this India audience (the app even ships a 'Vrat / fruit-only' fast type). V1 SCOPE: when the user picks the '16:8 window' fast type, capture the fast-start timestamp and show a calm circular progress ring (reuse the existing teal ring vocabulary) with 'Xh Ym fasted', the eating-window open time, and a state label (Fasting / Eating window open). Client-side only, NO backend: persist fastStart + window config in localStorage keyed by date; the ring updates from a 1-min interval; the existing 'End fast' button clears it. Skip push reminders and fast history in v1. EFFORT: roughly 1-2 days frontend, no backend, no schema -- extends the fasting toggle already on Nutrition.
issues.author: shakeebshaan

issues.description: [suggestion] Auto-generate a weekly grocery list from the assigned diet plan. USER PROBLEM: users get a 7-day plan (DietPlanWeek) but must manually work out what to buy to actually cook it — adherence dies at the grocery store, the biggest gap between having a plan and following it. EVIDENCE: the backend already serves per-ingredient data (name + quantity + unit) for every meal (RecipeDetail consumes recipe.ingredients); DietPlanWeek already loads the whole week. A grep shows zero existing grocery/shopping code, so this is a genuine gap. Comparable trackers (Mealime, Eat This Much, PlateJoy) ship auto grocery lists as a headline retention feature. V1 SCOPE: new route /diet-plan/shopping-list reached from a 'Shopping list' button on DietPlanWeek. Client-side only, NO backend change: flatten ingredients across the week's assigned meals, sum duplicates by normalised name+unit, sort alphabetically (skip a category taxonomy in v1), render a check-off list with checked state persisted in localStorage. Add one 'Copy as text / Share' button (WhatsApp-heavy India audience) so the list can be sent to whoever shops. EFFORT: roughly 1-2 days frontend, no backend, no schema. Reuses the existing diet-plan query and ingredient shape.

issues.reviewReason: Coach message fired at 3:55 AM local time — likely the APScheduler proactive message job dispatching at wrong local hour due to UTC vs IST offset. The scheduler runs in UTC; if the job is scheduled for 8am IST, it fires at 2:30am UTC which is 8am IST. But at 3:55am IST that would be ~10:25pm UTC the day before, suggesting a timezone offset bug. Owner-scope to fix (requires scheduler job timezone review in scheduler_jobs.py). Filed for tracking.
